reason: Both games run error-free in headless Chromium and fully meet the four requirements, but a008 verifiably fixed all five attacks, while a005's fix for its MAJOR core-loop fairness attack (shockwave gap vs. meteors) admittedly leaves a residual case (a meteor between the player and a far gap), so a008 is slightly more robust.
survived: silent save failure when storage is blocked: startup probe plus onFail red notice on the menu and result card
best and shards lost if the tab closes during the death animation: commitRun() now runs in die() and on pagehide
two tabs overwriting each other: Save.refresh() before every write plus a storage listener
AudioContext constructor throwing: graph built in try/catch, game runs silently
false claim that the game can never freeze: per-frame try/catch with recovery to the menu after 3 failed frames

a005: unavoidable shockwave and meteor deaths: mostly fixed by cross-checking spawners, but the author concedes a residual case where a meteor sits between the player and a far gap
